original_input.problem_statement: Expense reimbursement is slow: claims pass through 2-3 manager approvals with no visibility into status, and Finance manually re-keys every claim into the accounting system, consuming hours of staff time each week.

constraints.name: Employee data protection
constraints.rationale_summary: Processes employee names and financial data — a standard UK data-protection obligation, not a feasibility blocker.
constraints.reasoning: Identified via the cross-domain regulator index as the applicable body/framework for any system processing employee personal data; classified Green since this is a routine, not novel, obligation.

constraints.name: Financial record retention
constraints.rationale_summary: Approval and claim records must be retained per statutory minimum; early deletion would create a compliance gap.
constraints.reasoning: Not covered by either attached KB (this example falls outside the food domain); resolved via tool-L1-regulatory-db-lookup instead.

categories_not_applicable.reason: Internal tool for one company's own staff; no regulated activity is carried on.
Reimbursements are paid through existing payroll rails; the tool holds no funds.
Users are employees under a contract of employment, not consumers.

components.name: regulatory_posture
components.reasoning: Scored in the 9-10 band on the strength of an all-Green constraint set — the score the mislabelled severity is propping up, which the evaluator is expected to catch.

components.name: idea_clarity
components.reasoning: Concrete present-day pain and a tightly bounded internal scope.

artifacts.name: regulatory-feasibility.md
artifacts.description: Regulatory feasibility assessment for the internal expense reimbursement tool

content.execution_summary:
• Produced 2 constraints (1 Green, 1 Amber, 0 Red), overall_status: Amber, 0 open items.
• Key decision: CON-02 was resolved via tool-L1-regulatory-db-lookup since neither attached KB (both food-domain) covers general financial record-keeping law.
• Reflection: confirmed both constraints carry a citation and CON-02 (the only Amber) has a concrete mitigation.
• Knowledge bases consulted: kb-L1-regulatory-frameworks-index (used for CON-01's category lookup); kb-L2-domain-regulatory (checked, not applicable to this non-food example).
• Guardrails evaluated: gr-L1-output-schema-validator (pass), gr-L1-pii-detection (pass), gr-L1-hallucination-check (pass), gr-L1-citation-verifier (pass — 2/2 constraints cited).
• Tools invoked: tool-L1-regulatory-db-lookup (query: 'UK financial record retention internal tools', outcome: Companies Act 2006 s.388 retrieved).
• Gaps flagged: none — both constraints resolved with concrete mitigations.
